module: Debug display above each active vehicle: when enabled, onUpdate draws with debugDrawer the vehicle's id, its position and the rotation (quaternion) of its reference node, above its bounding box. The state change is signaled to the UI through the guihook vehicleDebugInfoEnabledChanged. The state is kept across a Lua reload.
notes: The three lines of text are drawn at the same position (textPos) with drawTextAdvanced: they may overlap depending on the engine implementation (inferred from code, no vertical offset is applied).
bdebugRequestViewportSize sends the size of the main ImGui window to the bdebug module on the vehicle side.

toggleDebugEnabled.desc: Toggles the display state and notifies the UI (vehicleDebugInfoEnabledChanged).

setDebugEnabled.desc: Enables or disables the display and notifies the UI.

bdebugRequestViewportSize.desc: Sends the vehicle the size of the main window (bdebug.receiveViewportSize(width, height)). No effect if the vehicle does not exist.

onUpdate.desc: Update hook: draws each active vehicle's debug information if the display is enabled.
